reason: v1.2.0 - the desktop runs the same native Rust engine as Android: one implementation of pacing, clearing, the proof resume, claims and per-send diagnostics. Closing the SDK context after every session (the way Cappa's 'SDK worker closed' does) stopped the stale Block Producer route from poisoning every session after the first; the proof got its own 8 s send budget because a proof cut at 600 ms left no verdict and no rejection on chain; the proof phase is bounded to 24 sends so a session can no longer sit eleven minutes; and a session the preserved proof lands now counts as landed instead of showing as failed. In the 2026-10-22 evening run six sessions in a row resolved, four of them accepted back to back. Minimum stays 1.1.9.
